levels.note: Street level with two entrance buildings: Triangeln Norra (north, by Rådmansgatan / S:t Johannes kyrka) and Triangeln Södra (south, by Smedjegatan / Kapellgatan). Names as on Skånetrafiken's map; OSM names the entrances "Norra uppgången" and "Södra uppgången".

levels.note: Intermediate level in OSM (escalator w158755495 at the north entrance, lift n2409796063 stops at -1 at the south entrance). Wikipedia mentions a "North entrance hall"; no source gives a signposted name or says what is on this level.

Platform level: one island platform, two tracks signposted Spår 1 and Spår 2 (Skånetrafiken), about 25 m below ground in a mined rock tunnel (Wikipedia, KHR). Trafikverket: platform 250 m long, 14.5 m wide, register tracks 71/74.

open: No owner page: Triangeln is not a Jernhusen station; Trafikverket/Skånetrafiken publish no station plan beyond the terminal map.
Lift and escalator positions rest on OSM; Skånetrafiken's map confirms lifts exist (legend) but not where. Whether there are fixed stairs besides the escalators is not in any source read.
Name and role of the intermediate level -1 (OSM) and its depth; platform depth is only "about 25 m" (Wikipedia, KHR).

Shops: none are inside the station per OSM; nearby 7-Eleven, Gateau, Joe & The Juice and WOSO are at the north entrance in Triangeln's buildings, Coffee Square at the south; their own websites were not read for hours.
